blocks.text: After Jalal or Jalidin falls, panic spreads quickly and Shamas Khan finds himself thrust into a new stage of conflict in which hesitation and fear already shape the field.
Advisers and kin try to restrain rash movement, but the death of a major figure makes renewed fighting unavoidable.
The page turns on the name Shamas Khan, because his reaction defines the next movement in the campaign.
